sentence: Jorkenuinely delectious things don't wait for you to finish chewing.

wombos.definition: In a manner that is genuinely John Pork — authentically and sincerely aligned with John Pork energy or lore.
wombos.example: He was jorkenuinely excited about that video.

wombos.definition: A state of being both delectable and delicious simultaneously — food or an experience so good that one superlative is not enough.
wombos.example: Those chicken tenders were absolutely delectious.
